The **Amalgamation** is a constructed consciousness that manifests as the guardian of the sealed stone door to the [[Grand Archive]]. It tests potential entrants for cognitive flexibility before granting access.

## Nature and Function
The Amalgamation presents as a sentient, testing entity bound to the archive's entrance. It requires both three brass insignias of the [[Secretive Brotherhood]] and the successful passage of its cognitive evaluation to bypass its arcane lock and open the door.

## Location
The Amalgamation is permanently located within the interstitial corridor behind the [[Salt-Vaults]], where it guards the entrance to the Grand Archive.
